source.title: YuCampus first proposal of survey questions, based on what NAAC (1.4.1, 2.7.1) and NBA (indirect attainment) ask colleges to collect. Not yet checked by an IQAC expert.

templates.name: Student satisfaction
templates.description: How students rate teaching, learning and support.

questions.text: The syllabus was covered in time.
Teachers come well prepared and explain clearly.
Internal assessment is fair and transparent.
Teachers use examples, projects and activities, not only lectures.
Mentoring helps me with my studies and problems.
Labs, library and internet support my learning.
Overall, I am satisfied with teaching and learning here.
What one thing should the college improve?

templates.name: Course exit survey
templates.description: At the end of a course: how well students think they reached each course outcome.

questions.text: What would have helped you learn this course better?

templates.name: Alumni feedback
templates.description: How well the curriculum prepared former students for work and further study.

questions.text: The curriculum prepared me for my career.
There was enough practical and lab work.
Industry exposure (visits, internships, talks) was useful.
Placement and career support were helpful.
I would recommend this college to others.
What should the curriculum add or change?

templates.name: Employer feedback
templates.description: How employers rate the graduates they hired.

questions.text: Graduates from this college have the knowledge the job needs.
They communicate well.
They work well in teams.
They learn new things quickly.
They act professionally and ethically.
Overall, we are satisfied with graduates from this college.
Which skills should the college strengthen?

templates.name: Parent feedback
templates.description: How parents see teaching, facilities and communication.

questions.text: My ward is taught well.
The college keeps me informed about attendance and marks.
The campus is safe and disciplined.
Facilities (labs, library, hostel, transport) are good.
Overall, I am satisfied with the college.
What would you like the college to do better?

templates.name: Teacher feedback on curriculum
templates.description: How teachers rate the syllabus they teach.

questions.text: The syllabus matches the course objectives.
The syllabus is up to date with the field.
The prescribed books and references are adequate.
The balance of theory and practice is right.
There is enough time to cover the syllabus.
What should be added to or removed from the syllabus?
